name: Filthium Zero
description:
About This Game



WELCOME TO EARTH, UNIT!

Filthium Zero is a compact action roguelite experience featuring a mix of vertical and ground combat. Purge the Filthium-infested Earth, battle hordes of mutants, unlock powerful upgrades to survive, and watch the ragdolls fly in this short and explosive joyride.

VERTICAL & GROUND COMBAT

Bounce off slimes to launch into the air, throw your Extraction Barrel from the sky for a heavy impact, slam yourself down with force, and send ragdolls flying in every direction. Activate and combine powerful abilities, collect resources, and customize the next UNIT with a growing arsenal of upgrades.

PURGE, SURVIVE, ADVANCE

Your mission: purge the corrupted zones of Earth by extracting Filthium from the water and depositing it into Collectors, while defeating hordes of zombies and mutants. Each deployment is a new UNIT soldier, armed with upgrades secured by their predecessors. Gather resources, improve survival odds, and push UNIT’s mission forward - one soldier at a time.

DEPLOY NOW, UNIT!
